Iran’s top military command says it will strike U.S. and allied energy, IT, and desalination infrastructure across the Middle East if the U.S. targets Iranian energy sites — a response after Trump threatened to “obliterate” Iran’s power plants within 48 hours if the Strait of Hormuz isn’t reopened.
